meta.title: Prompt Optimizer
meta.description: Turns raw prompt drafts or vague requirements into structured, executable system prompts: concretizes vague wording, fills in missing style/quality/effect dimensions by scenario, and outputs six sections (role, goal, workflow, output spec, constraints, thinking rules). Write your requirement in the composer and click One-click optimize: the optimized prompt is written straight back into the composer without sending, so you can keep editing or send it yourself.
